rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun in accusative singular masculine
absolutive of the root jñā (to know)
compound of gūḍha (hidden) and sadbhāva (true nature), accusative singular masculine
neuter abstract noun in accusative singular
middle present third singular of pra-jā (to be born or arise)

items.question: What arises when one knows the hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing the hidden true nature causes all-knowingness.
items.inference: Knowledge of the hidden true nature produces omniscience.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ is not fully explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
